title: Boundaries and assertiveness
learning_outcomes: Explain boundaries versus control in the context of boundaries and assertiveness.
Compare and distinguish assertive requests in the context of boundaries and assertiveness.
Apply declining in the context of boundaries and assertiveness.
Evaluate and justify decisions about safety and follow-through in the context of boundaries and assertiveness.

lessons.title: Boundaries versus control
lessons.outcome: Explain boundaries versus control in the context of boundaries and assertiveness.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving boundaries versus control; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Create an annotated explanation with a concrete example and a counterexample. Connect the result to boundary scripts.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain boundaries versus control from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of boundaries versus control; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Assertive requests
lessons.outcome: Compare and distinguish assertive requests in the context of boundaries and assertiveness.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving assertive requests; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Compare two cases or approaches using explicit criteria; identify an important limitation. Connect the result to boundary scripts.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain assertive requests from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of assertive requests; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Declining
lessons.outcome: Apply declining in the context of boundaries and assertiveness.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving declining; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Work through a new case or simulation; document assumptions and steps. Connect the result to boundary scripts.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain declining from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of declining; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Safety and follow-through
lessons.outcome: Evaluate and justify decisions about safety and follow-through in the context of boundaries and assertiveness.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving safety and follow-through; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Analyse an unfamiliar case; defend a choice, identify uncertainty and revise after feedback. Connect the result to boundary scripts.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain safety and follow-through from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of safety and follow-through; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

criteria.criterion: Accurate explanation of boundaries versus control; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of assertive requests; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of declining; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of safety and follow-through; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

assessment.threshold: All mapped criteria at level 2; no averaging away missing criteria. Level 3 requires independent novel application, delayed reassessment and appropriate review.
assessment.alternate_evidence: Equivalent accessible written, oral, visual, simulated or supervised evidence; no personal disclosure required.

safety.notes: Draft educational framework only. Use fictional cases; no personal diagnosis, prescription, hazardous practice, financial/legal instruction or unqualified certification. Obtain qualified/local review before publication.
